theme_short: The week your computer became the cloud
theme: **The week your computer became the cloud.** Three of this week's ten run entirely on your own machine - voice cloning, a 125-billion-parameter AI, and evidence-based life advice - replacing services that used to need a subscription and someone else's server. The rest arm your AI coding agent with skills, diagrams, safety rails and a video studio.
method: **How this week was picked:** 226 candidates from 6 sources (GitHub Trending, Trendshift, skills.sh, findarepo, Hacker News, tips). YouTube was not scanned (CAPTCHA in cloud). 14 cleared all floors. Picks: 6 by score, 2 new this week (under 45 days), 1 still climbing (over 90 days), 1 extra by score (only 2 new-this-week candidates available). **Every repo passed our safety check on Oct 2.** Re-check: ai-memory and DeepSeek-Reasonix now FAIL (new unpatched advisories, added to blocklist and removed from site). KiroCrew was removed after a full re-check found its Sep 28 security advisory still unpatched; it is on the blocklist. Tips: none this week (data/tips.md empty).

picks.name: HyperFrames
picks.oneliner: A video maker for AI: describe what you want, and out comes a polished MP4 - no camera, no editing app.

picks.name: Strata
picks.oneliner: Run a powerful AI on your own gaming PC - no cloud, no subscription, no data leaving your machine.

picks.name: VoiceStudio
picks.oneliner: A free voice studio on your own computer: clone a voice, dub a video, or dictate in 646 languages - nothing uploaded.

picks.name: HowToLiveBetter
picks.oneliner: A free, evidence-graded cheat sheet for life: 650 recommendations on health, money, law and more, each with its cost and payoff.

picks.name: Ponytail
picks.oneliner: A one-line plugin that makes your AI coding agent write less code - it thinks like the laziest senior developer in the room.

picks.name: Archify
picks.oneliner: Point an AI agent at your codebase and get a validated architecture diagram - not a guess, a verified map.

picks.name: Skills
picks.oneliner: A curated box of 27 agent skills for Claude Code - from test-driven development to debugging to architecture reviews.

picks.name: ECC
picks.oneliner: A free plugin that turns Claude Code into a full engineering team - 261 skills, 63 sub-agents, 79 commands.

picks.name: AI Engineering from Scratch
picks.oneliner: A free 523-lesson curriculum that teaches AI engineering by building real projects - from zero to deploying production systems.

picks.name: OpenShell
picks.oneliner: A safety sandbox from NVIDIA that keeps AI agents from doing damage - they run inside a locked room with a one-way mirror.
